in_hebrew.name: Armbruster
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Arms of the rock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Armbruster הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Name derived from the Old German elements 'arm' meaning 'arm' and 'brust' meaning 'rock'. Historically, this name was given to someone who was strong and protected their people like a rock.
